horoscope: You may be conducting yourself with more personal presence and credibility today, dear Aries, with Mars in a favorable aspect to Saturn in your sign. You are tempering your energy and displaying patience, and people are taking you seriously. You're also taking your needs for entertainment, romance, or diversions quite seriously, and you might put energy into plans that help you achieve a goal related to personal fulfillment and pleasure. While you may have come across strongly in recent days, you are tempering your energy and showing patience now. Not everything works best spontaneously -- some things benefit from planning and practicing. You are feeling freer, lighter, and more forward-looking as the day advances, and you are especially charismatic as a result. You can be feeling especially confident about creative work, and you can be quite industrious and resourceful now.

You're basing your confidence on realism today, dear Taurus, and the major goal is to feel on top of things. Taking steps towards getting over a fear or habit could also be in focus. You're ready to embrace a deliberate pace, seeing its distinct benefits. Mars and Saturn harmonize, and while neither is a particularly easy planet, their collaboration can encourage you to produce and excel. You're ready to work hard for your future security. Responsibilities are more easily met today. This is a good day for productivity, but as the day advances, it's also strong for communicating your ideas with persuasion. If you're working on something behind the scenes or independently, this can be a good time for really going at it.

You're likely to make good use of a deliberate pace today, dear Gemini, as Mars and Saturn harmonize. You can be ready to put in some effort towards achieving your goals, particularly those related to learning, communicating, and connecting. If you can benefit from some study, this is a great time to do so. Whether you're catching up or getting ahead of yourself, efforts to learn can be very successful now. Others are very interested in what you say, and they may turn to you for sage advice. It's an excellent time to brush up on your knowledge and develop skills. Personal magnetism runs high now, particularly with friends.

Mars forms a harmonious aspect with Saturn today, dear Cancer, which is useful for motivating you to pay more attention to practical activities. This is a good time to work on career or money-making projects or take steps towards a practical goal. You recognize the importance of strategy and patience. This can be a good day for putting your talents and skills to beneficial use. Strategy, planning, seeing patterns, and developing methods are in good form, particularly related to work, business, and finances. You could find that others are willing to go along with your plans and they're responsive to your insights, allowing you to take the lead. While there is strong energy for practical affairs today, it's also a fine time for emotional connections.

Your appetite for instant results and pleasure is stronger these days, dear Leo, and most of the time, this helps you feel motivated. Other times, and quite likely this morning, you're ready to apply yourself more carefully, and it pays off. You're interested in tangible results and rewards as Mars, currently animating your sign, harmonizes with steady Saturn. Practical decision-making is enhanced, but you're also very interested in doing, not just thinking, mainly revolving around personal plans and initiatives. There can be a productive boost related to education or publishing now. You're earning respect, particularly for what you know or how you share your ideas. You can find many reasons to feel encouraged and positive about the future, particularly as the day advances. You can be filled with initiative at this time.

You're inclined to approach your activities smartly and productively today, dear Virgo. Slowly but surely, plans and strategies are developing. With Mars and Saturn in private sectors of your chart and in harmony, you're more likely to work behind the scenes, and quite successfully. It's a good time to tackle activities that require determination. You have the patience to see things through, or at least to work on things that don't offer immediate rewards or results. You're far more interested in putting your efforts into endeavors that will last.

Today's Mars-Saturn transit adds a practical, patient, stabilizing theme to your day, dear Libra. Accepting people, projects, and circumstances as they are, and then working with what you have, is the key to success now. There is beauty in seeing people this way, as exactly who they are, as this reduces pressure and puts everyone at ease. Putting energy into a group effort can be worthwhile right now, and doing business with friends can also work out well today. Good energy is with you for productive cooperation or collaboration, so that if you want to get something important done, you may want to partner up and combine talents. It's a good time for being with others in general, even if you don't have a project to complete. Getting a handle on practical matters of all kinds, and especially money, can be a little more natural, easy, and intuitive right now. Problems seem a little easier to solve right now, possibly because you're enjoying the process of looking for solutions.

Today's energies make it easy to put emotions and expectations aside to work towards a particular goal with patience, dear Scorpio. You can be a workhorse today, responsible, reliable, and ready to take on anything that moves you toward a good place. You're also likely to be valued on a professional or public level, even in small ways, as others recognize the effort you put forth. As much as you'd like to charge ahead, this is a day for putting in the necessary groundwork. It's a fine time for work efforts, support from superiors, reputation matters, and any project that benefits from you taking the lead.

Your motivation is strong today, dear Sagittarius, but you're pacing yourself, and it's a great strategy now. You recognize that taking things one step at a time can help you make progress. It's not the time to jump into something you haven't given much thought to. Your time is better spent today putting effort into a sure thing. This is a fine time to employ strategy and exercise self-discipline. You might make a creative, educational, or travel-related advance. It's a good day to hone a skill, perfect a craft, or put effort into a heartfelt project or venture. You are especially industrious and might come up with inventive ideas and practical solutions.

The Moon heads into your sign today, dear Capricorn, and your emotions need clear channels for expression. A Mars-Saturn transit puts you in a great position to enjoy the benefits of a slow-but-steady approach. Some behind-the-scenes work, or efforts made in private or solitude, can be attractive or necessary today. It can please you to do something charitable or to take action on an important matter anonymously now. You may make progress on the home front, and if you are working at home, you want to put effort into things that will last. There may be a project going on that is in development stages that consumes much of your attention, or you could be handling matters that help you get more organized and feel more in control of your life.

You might enjoy and even embrace a slower pace today, dear Aquarius, and success today depends on how patient and deliberate you can be. Thinking in terms of security and practicality will bring rewards. You have a stronger sense than usual about which of your ideas and plans have real potential, and it can be rather easy to get completely absorbed in a project now. Very productive conversations can happen, particularly with a partner or in a one-on-one situation. Communicating in real, honest terms can be most effective now. Even so, the Moon heads into your privacy sector, and you tend to keep a low profile. It's best to take things easy on an emotional level as you recharge.

The day shapes up to be quite excellent for applying yourself to something useful, dear Pisces. You do need to take things slowly and one step at a time for the best results under the influence of today's Mars-Saturn trine. You are naturally drawn to the most practical solutions to problems and to projects or endeavors that are constructive. Getting serious about your finances can be beneficial and in focus, and thinking about long-term purchases, work projects, or investments can figure strongly. Although you should probably wait until after Venus' retrograde to make significant outlays, this is a good time to assess things, draw up plans, or do the groundwork. Traditional methods are favored, and so is seniority, both in business and your personal life today.
